title: Session Replay | LogRocket
text:
Session Replay for product, design & marketing
Session Replay
Watch every user session with a pixel-perfect replay
Understand how users engage with your website and apps
Capture every user event and activity automatically
Start for free
Pixel-perfect session replay
100% accurate reproduction and playback of every user session across your web and native mobile apps, exactly as the user saw it.
"LogRocket has data we can't get anywhere else."
Rachel Miner
Sr. Product Manager
Event timeline & user metadata
Get complete context into every session by capturing every user action and event automatically, alongside user identification, metadata, and custom traits.
Filters & search
Search for sessions by user information, errors, URLs, or 50+ other options. Combine multiple filters to create unique user cohorts that can be used throughout LogRocket.
AI surfaces the moments that matter
Galileo Highlights watches and summarizes sessions for you, letting you diagnose what happened to a user without needing to watch their session.
Exclude sensitive data
Mask your most sensitive user data (SSNs, credit card info, dates of birth, etc.). LogRocket lets you easily mask information so that it never shows up in a user’s session replay or on our servers.
Collaborate with engineering
Share problematic sessions with engineering teams, who have all the information required for rapid bug and issue resolution.
Integrations
Out-of-the-box integrations allow LogRocket to enhance existing workflows.
Connect customer feedback to the sessions that prompted it with NPS and VoC tools
Send sessions directly to issue management tools
Create seamless, issue-free user experiences
